title: Email: Configure SMTP and Send a Test Email | Orchard Core
description:
A site that cannot send email cannot confirm accounts, reset passwords, or deliver notifications. Orchard Core sends email through a provider, and the Email feature holds the settings that choose it.

This video enables the SMTP Email Provider, connects the site to an SMTP server, and sends a test email from the Email Test page. A local test mail server catches the message, so you can see what the site sent.

In this video:
• Where a site sends email, and the Email and SMTP Email Provider features
• Enabling the provider under Tools, Features
• Configuring the SMTP provider under Settings, Communication, Email
• Sending a test email under Tools, Testing, Email Test
• Checking the message in a local test mail server
• What to check when a test fails
